title: Koru CRS
description: Coordinate reference system of a dataset. Real-world maps reference an EPSG code; game maps use a local, engine-specific coordinate space described by its unit, scale and axis orientation.

type.description: geographic = lon/lat degrees (e.g. EPSG:4326), projected = planar units (e.g. EPSG:2180).

unit.description: Native unit of the coordinate space, e.g. 'meter', 'tile', 'cell', 'game-unit'.

meters_per_unit.description: Scale to real-world meters when the game defines one, otherwise null.

origin.description: Location of the coordinate origin, in native units, relative to the map's top-left corner.

axis.description: Orientation of canonical x/y after normalization. Engines with a vertical y axis (x/z ground plane) must be mapped to x/y by processing.
